name: MDMB-CHMICA
summary: MDMB-CHMICA is an indole-based synthetic cannabinoid that is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor and has been sold online as a designer drug. While MDMB-CHMICA was initially sold under the name "MMB-CHMINACA", the compound corresponding to this code name has been identified on the designer drug market in 2015 as AMB-CHMINACA.
